g.text: ON STEM WALLS PER S-101, 36" GUARD
LOT 14, BLOCK C, HERON SOUND ESTATES
NO SEAL. NO ENGINEER OF RECORD.
DIMENSIONS ARE TO THE FACE OF MASONRY OR THE FACE OF STUD UNLESS NOTED. DO
EXTERIOR WALLS OF THE FIRST FLOOR ARE 8" CMU WITH A REINFORCED TIE BEAM. SEE
ALL EXTERIOR GLAZED OPENINGS ARE IMPACT RATED FOR THE DESIGN PRESSURES ON
GARAGE SEPARATION (FBC-R R302.6): 5/8" TYPE X GYPSUM BOARD ON THE GARAGE CEILING
BELOW BEDROOM 2 AND THE HALL, 1/2" GYPSUM BOARD ON THE GARAGE WALLS AND ON
STRUCTURE SUPPORTING THE CEILING. DOOR 103: SOLID CORE 1 3/8" MIN., SELF-CLOSING
FLOOD VENTS: 4 ENGINEERED VENTS, EACH CERTIFIED (ICC-ES) TO COVER 200 SQ. FT. OF
ENCLOSED AREA: 4 X 200 = 800 SQ. FT. >= 528 SQ. FT. GROSS GARAGE AREA. BOTTOM
WITHIN 12" OF GRADE, ON TWO WALLS (FBC-R R322.2.2). LOCATIONS PER S-101.
SMOKE AND CARBON MONOXIDE ALARMS PER E-101, INTERCONNECTED.
MAIN STAIR: 18 RISERS AT 7.68" (7 3/4" MAX.), 17 TREADS AT 10", 36" LANDINGS TOP AND
BOTTOM, HANDRAIL 34"-38" ABOVE THE NOSINGS, GUARD 36" MIN. (FBC-R R311.7).
GARAGE STEPS AT DOOR 103: 36" LANDING, 4 RISERS AT 7 1/2", TREADS 10", HANDRAIL ONE
SIDE. ENTRY STAIR: 5 RISERS AT 6 3/8", TREADS 11", HANDRAILS BOTH SIDES. LANAI STEPS:
4 RISERS AT 6 13/16", TREADS 11", HANDRAILS BOTH SIDES.
GUARDS 36" HIGH AT THE PORCH AND LANAI EDGES, WHICH ARE 32" ABOVE FINISHED
GRADE (8.00' NAVD), WITH NO OPENING A 4" SPHERE PASSES (FBC-R R312.1).
ROOM AREAS ON THE TAGS ARE NET, TO THE INSIDE FACE OF THE WALLS. G-001
